caption:
Massage done, and it's leg day. Should Lulu go heavy? It depends on the session and what you're training.

A walk, easy cycling or your physio exercises are generally fine afterwards, and a nice way to enjoy that looser feeling. After deep work, some people feel heavy or less springy for a few hours, so many save max lifts and sprints for the next day.

Got a key session this week? Book your massage after it, or a day or two before. Massage complements strength training rather than replacing it, so keep your usual program going. Soreness lasting days or swelling is worth getting checked.

Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio ask about your training week and tailor pressure and timing. Book online via the link in bio.
